title: Harmonicon Lesson Manifest
description: One lesson in the curriculum: localized title/body keys, an optional playable chart, prerequisites, and pass criteria.

id.description: Stable identifier, unique across all lessons. Used as the profile key and in other lessons' prerequisites — never rename one that has shipped.

unit.description: Unit identifier grouping lessons in the menu. Localized via the Fluent key `lesson-unit-<unit>`.

optional.description: Marks an elective lesson. Electives keep their own prerequisites but never count toward unit gates or block the required course. Absent/false = core curriculum.

track.description: Which row of the skill tree this lesson sits in (see docs/training_tree_plan.md). Optional: falls back to `unit`, so an externally authored lesson without one still groups sensibly. Localized via the Fluent key `lesson-track-<track>`.

title_key.description: Fluent key for the lesson's title.

body_key.description: Fluent key for the lesson's instructional body text.

chart.description: Path to a .harpchart, relative to the lesson's own directory. Absent = instructional-only lesson (no playable drill).

aural.description: Hide the scrolling note prompts during a chart-backed ear-training lesson. The synthesized call still plays and scoring still waits for the response. Absent/false keeps ordinary visual prompts.

prerequisites.description: Lesson ids that must be passed before this one unlocks.

threshold.description: Minimum overall weighted accuracy (0..1) to pass.

technique.description: Technique bucket name — the same vocabulary SongStats/profile use.

threshold.description: Minimum accuracy (0..1) on that technique's notes to pass.
Minimum fraction (0..1) of notes played during the jam that were at least in-scale. Routes the lesson into Jam Session instead of the normal chart pipeline — see PassCriteria::ScaleAdherence.

Minimum fraction (0..1) of notes played during the jam that were specifically chord tones (stricter than scale-adherence). Routes into Jam Session like scale-adherence — see PassCriteria::ChordToneAdherence.
Minimum fraction (0..1) of notes played outside a rest window of the jam's play/rest bar pattern. Routes into Jam Session like scale-adherence — see PassCriteria::PhraseDiscipline.

pass_criteria.description: How a chart-backed lesson is judged at the results screen (or, for a scale-adherence/chord-tone-adherence/phrase-discipline lesson, by its own "Finish Lesson" jam pause-menu button — see PassCriteria::ScaleAdherence). Absent = playing it through at all counts as done (or, for instructional-only lessons, the reader's Mark-as-Done button).

training.description: Generated practice drills for this lesson (docs/training_tree_plan.md). Absent means the lesson has no trainings, which is correct for anything instructional-only: where the microphone cannot verify the technique, five exercises would only pretend to check it.

technique.description: What the drills train. Only techniques that change which pitch a hole produces; an expression technique shapes a note rather than choosing it and needs a different generator.

holes.description: Holes the lesson covers, in teaching order. The first is what the isolating tiers drill on its own.

seed.description: Fixes the generated order so a retry is the same exercise. Derived from the lesson id when absent.

progression.description: A jam-based lesson's backing progression, seeded into the jam when Start routes into it. Absent = Standard. See menu::lessons::parse_progression.

scale.description: A jam-based lesson's scale for live scale-adherence feedback, seeded into JamScale when Start routes into it. Absent = first-position (the blues hexatonic). See menu::lessons::parse_scale.

diagram.description: An instructional lesson's embedded reference diagram, rendered by the lesson reader alongside the body text. Absent = no diagram. See dialogs::circle_of_fifths.

widgets.description: Reusable teaching aids rendered below the lesson body. Absent means the lesson has no embedded tools.

position_cycle.description: A jam-based lesson that periodically calls a new position (cycling JamScale through First/Second/Third position every few bars), seeded into JamPositionCycle when Start routes into it. Absent/false = the jam's scale field stays fixed for the whole session. See jam::position_guide.
